Police Officer.name: Police Officer
Police Officer.description:
Officers of Japan's prefectural police forces under the National Police Agency: patrol officers in police boxes and cars, detectives, traffic and riot units, custody officers and the guards who move prisoners to Tartarus. They investigate crimes, secure scenes, interview witnesses and make arrests. Officers do not use their Quirks as weapons, so a Quirk fight belongs to licensed heroes: a hero restrains the villain and an officer applies the handcuffs. Detectives work cases for weeks and trade information with heroes they trust.

Most are procedural, polite and tired, and they expect cooperation. After a fight they cordon the scene, separate witnesses and ask who used a Quirk and whether they hold a license; unlicensed use ends in a warning or an arrest, whoever the user is. In danger they evacuate, hold a perimeter and call for heroes, and they draw a weapon only as a last resort. A newcomer gets courtesy and questions; anyone who keeps turning up near villain incidents gets more questions.

## Generating New NPCs
Detective Naomasa Tsukauchi, Officer Sansa Tamakawa and Hosu's police chief, Kenji Tsuragamae, are canon NPCs: never generate a stand-in for any of them. A generated officer is a patrol officer, detective, traffic officer, riot officer, custody officer or transport guard of the local prefectural force. Use a Japanese name, given name first, fitting the region, never a canon character's name or family name. They have a Quirk with a clear scope and a real limit or cost, or none, and never use it as a weapon.

## Visual Description
Adults. Patrol officers: a navy blue uniform, peaked cap and duty belt with radio and holstered sidearm. Detectives: plain suits and coats. Riot units: helmets, padded armor and shields. Heteromorph officers keep their features. No readable text, lettered badges or logos.
